about: Exp 012 (S): bat impacts on the bedroom door, per recording (the four 'bat hammers door' files of story/follower_bat, 1-4). Each onset is [seconds into the file, strength]; strength 1 = a full blow (the door jolts), about 0.5 = the bounce right after it (a smaller rattle). Found by StoryAudio.impact_onsets (5 ms RMS windows, a rise of more than 14 dB within 60 ms to within 22 dB of the loudest). 'offset' shifts one file's onsets (seconds, + = later); 'latency' shifts all of them (output latency). F10 > Audio > Test door impacts plays one with the door.
